selected_primary_idea.title: MOSAIC: Mechanism-Observable State Atlas and Invariance Calibration
selected_primary_idea.summary: A falsifiable cross-domain program that asks whether a shared conditional latent-state model predicts collective-motion observables without assuming a universal microscopic rule.
selected_primary_idea.scientific_object: trajectory- and field-level collective states in birds, fish, bacteria or microswimmers, and robot swarms
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: conditional balance among activity, coupling, noise, delay, and geometry, with domain-specific observation maps
falsification_conditions: shared model misses the pre-registered held-out predictive margin
latent states are not measurement-invariant after allowed calibration
apparent transfer disappears after geometry or delay is controlled
selected_primary_idea.validation_structure: blocked out-of-sample forecasts, held-out domain transfer, perturbation-context checks, and comparison with domain-specific baselines
